notes.title: Gamer Stop Simulator — DevLog #1
notes.content:
Hello Gamers,

First of all, thank you for your interest in our game! 🙌
If you still haven't added our main game to your wishlist, we highly recommend that you do to support us:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499220/Gamer_Stop_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674899/0d1fc991e2c73a87d6d34f9b0924b36ad4f0ceec.png"][/img]

🕹️ Retro Cassette Vending Machine
A retro game cassette vending machine is now available in your store!

You can get random cassette packs by inserting a token.

You can find rare and valuable retro cassettes.

You can sell these cassettes for higher prices or create your own special collection.

For collectors, this feature adds both a nostalgic flavor and an economic strategy to the game.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674899/bed4256cc757494df72b4c94bd2dc812df4c828f.gif"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674899/27983775df3c36d27b04c0d5a2ef94358077baa4.png"][/img]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674899/15d738696fc0504a93576a0f71469ed37485da1b.png"][/img]
📦 Online Ordering System
With the new online ordering feature, you now have to deal not only with customers who come to your store but also with customers who place orders online.

You can see new orders on your computer.

Once you accept an order, you need to prepare the product and place it in a shipping package.

Then you deliver it to the cargo company to be delivered to the customer.

Attention! Every order has a delivery time. If you don't deliver on time, you may face customer dissatisfaction.

Thanks to this feature, players now experience a real e-commerce experience while managing their own small businesses.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674899/31cad109aa6cfe5e82d47b1659694ae963052904.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674899/382e79798188dbd65b77920cae901a70eb165477.png"][/img]
